about.text: The 1st Police District, also known as the Central District, is generally bordered by Lake Michigan to the East, the highway to the West, the Chicago River to the North and 31st Street to the South. Residents live in the Loop, Lakeshore East, West Loop Gate, South Loop, Prairie District and Douglas neighborhoods and includes parts of the 3rd, 4th, 11th, 25th, 28th, 34th, and 42nd aldermanic wards. The 1st District includes the Central Business District, the Cultural Mile, Millennium Park, Grant Park, McCormick Place, the Museum Campus, and Soldier Field. The Central District welcomes many visitors during large events and experiences like Lollapalooza, Sueños, the Grant Park Music Festival, the Jazz and Blues Festivals, Taste of Chicago, the start and finish of the Chicago Marathon, and the Christkindlmarket.

source.name: Community Commission for Public Safety and Accountability
